connector.name: Emercoin Agent
connector.registryDescription: On-chain identity and durable memory for AI agents on the Emercoin blockchain (NVS).
connector.summary: Hosted at ai.emercoin.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image mcp:0.1.0. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the emercoin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <session JWT> from https://ai.emercoin.com/login — required for write tools; read tools are open

env.name: GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Base URL of the edge gateway the MCP server talks to
